title: Dedupe by id
hints: A plain `<T>` doesn't know that `item.id` exists. Constrain it: `<T extends { id: number }>`.
Keep a `Set<number>` of ids you've already seen. `seen.has(id)` is fast even for huge lists.
return items.filter((item) => { if (seen.has(item.id)) return false; seen.add(item.id); return true; });
